title: Migrate 13 k8s-demo.de ingresses to cert-manager
description: Update ingresses to use cert-manager annotations instead of Traefik certresolver: linkding, demo-api, demo-django, docker.nexus, docker-registry, freelance-radar, grafana, nexus, prometheus, registry, tested-django, wordpress, dashboard

title: Keycloak Phase 1: create base manifests
description: Create all files under apps/base/keycloak/: namespace.yaml, pvc.yaml, secret.yaml (with placeholder password), deployment.yaml, service.yaml, middleware-tailscale.yaml, ingress.yaml (two objects: public + admin with Tailscale middleware), kustomization.yaml.

title: Create ClusterIssuer for Hetzner DNS-01
description: Configure Let's Encrypt ClusterIssuer using Hetzner DNS-01 solver for k8s-demo.de

title: Remove legacy Traefik Cloudflare certresolver for k8s-demo.de
description: After migration complete, clean up unused Cloudflare certresolver config and acme.json entries for k8s-demo.de

title: Fix Terraform DNS config: hcloud_zone doesn't support inline rrsets blocks
description: The terraform/dns/main.tf uses dynamic rrsets blocks inside hcloud_zone resource, but this isn't supported by the hetznercloud/hcloud provider. DNS records need to be created as separate hcloud_zone_record resources. GitHub Actions workflow dns-management.yml fails on terraform validate.

title: Rollback: Traefik dual certresolver (Cloudflare + Hetzner)
description:
If Traefik cert issues occur after deploying dual resolvers, rollback with:

1. cp infrastructure/base/traefik/helmchartconfig.yaml.backup infrastructure/base/traefik/helmchartconfig.yaml
2. git checkout -- infrastructure/base/traefik/kustomization.yaml apps/base/wp-ai-chatbot-redirect/ingress.yaml
3. rm infrastructure/base/traefik/hetzner-secret.yaml
4. git add -A && git commit -m 'Rollback Traefik dual certresolver' && git push
5. flux reconcile kustomization flux-system --with-source

Backup file: infrastructure/base/traefik/helmchartconfig.yaml.backup

title: Add cert-manager Hetzner DNS webhook
description: Install cert-manager-webhook-hetzner for DNS-01 challenges with Hetzner Cloud API

title: Install cert-manager in cluster
description: Install cert-manager via Helm for centralized certificate management

title: Keycloak Phase 1: encrypt secret with SOPS
description: Edit apps/base/keycloak/secret.yaml with the real admin password, then encrypt in-place with: sops --encrypt --in-place apps/base/keycloak/secret.yaml. Verify with: grep ENC apps/base/keycloak/secret.yaml. Do NOT commit unencrypted.

title: Keycloak Phase 1: commit and deploy
description: git add apps/ && git commit && git push, then: flux reconcile kustomization apps --with-source. Wait for pod to reach Running state (startup takes 60–90s).

title: Add external-dns with Hetzner webhook for k8s-demo.de
description: Deploy external-dns-hetzner-webhook (ghcr.io/mconfalonieri/external-dns-hetzner-webhook) with USE_CLOUD_API=true for automatic DNS record creation on k8s-demo.de via api.hetzner.cloud

title: Keycloak Phase 1: create staging overlay
description: Create apps/staging/keycloak/kustomization.yaml pointing to ../../base/keycloak. Then add '- keycloak' to the resources list in apps/staging/kustomization.yaml.

title: Keycloak Phase 1: smoke test (all 9 must pass)
description:
Run all 9 checks:
1. Pod 1/1 Running
2. Watch logs for startup (kubectl logs -n keycloak -l app=keycloak -f)
3. PVC Bound
4. Ingress ADDRESS populated
5. DNS resolves (dig auth.kubetest.uk)
6. /health/ready returns {"status":"UP"} publicly
7. OIDC issuer = https://auth.kubetest.uk/realms/master
8. /admin from internet returns 403
9. /admin from Tailscale device loads Admin Console
(+) cluster-internal DNS: curl http://keycloak.keycloak.svc.cluster.local:8080/health/ready

All 9 must pass before Phase 2 (Django) can start.
